## Checklist

- [ ] `dotnet test -c Release` passes
- [ ] Added or updated tests covering this change
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] Updated the relevant docs under `docs/`
- [ ] Public API additions have XML doc comments
- [ ] No new runtime package dependencies added to the library project
